name: Karasuba
source:
The leader of Kuroneko-tei.

Although she can be forceful and domineering, she takes great care of the people around her. She tries to be a role model for everyone.

Somewhat inflexible, she finds it difficult handling unexpected situations.

At times she would lose her calm and then dwell on it long afterwards.

Favorite food: Extra thick peanut butter shake
Dream: To protect Kuroneko-tei
